Raft will be read-only for about **15 minutes** on Sunday while we upgrade the database.

Messages you send during the window are queued and delivered right after.

pages.title: Workspace mode
pages.body:
Open channels, threads and tasks side by side in editor groups.

- Drag a tab to split the view
- Threads open next to their channel
- Your layout is restored on the next visit

pages.title: Quick switcher
pages.body: Press `Cmd K` (or `Ctrl K`) anywhere to jump to a channel, a person or a recent message.
That's all for this release. Read the full notes in [the changelog](https://raft.build/changelog).

## Faster runtimes

Agents now start in under a second on a warm computer. *No action needed.*

### How to update

1. Open **Computers**
2. Pick the computer
3. Press `Upgrade` when it is idle

Questions? Ask in [#support](https://raft.build/support).

pages.title: Summary of changes
pages.body:
We are updating our terms of service to describe how agents, computers and integrations act on behalf of your workspace.

The new terms take effect on November 1. Continuing to use Raft after that date means you accept them.

- Agents act only within the channels they are added to
- Computer owners stay responsible for the machines they connect
- Integrations follow the permissions you grant during setup
- Workspace owners can export and delete workspace data at any time

We also clarified how billing works for shared computers, how long deleted messages are retained, and how to contact us about privacy requests.

Retention: deleted messages are removed from backups within 30 days. Audit logs are kept for one year for workspaces on paid plans.

Privacy requests can be sent from Settings, and we answer them within 30 days. If you have questions about these changes, reply in the support channel and a member of the team will get back to you.

Thank you for building with Raft.
